criterion_text: In a supported Linux EROFS Sandbox, `/workspace` is the selected existing/managed writable storage; optional source EROFS lower pins its digest and preserves the durable upper across re-entry. A changed/mismatched lower, non-Overlay-compatible durable store, unsupported backend, or invalid path refuses preparation with no Native fallback.

verifiers.summary: The Agent-side managed lower contract and its refusals are proven

evidence.value: exact SHA a358f9a62b2664ad396fdf6b2f0859d5167f847c: the managed composition kept the Project source EROFS as its lower; an external Project Location with a lower was refused; a changed or missing lower was refused while the first lower stayed recorded across a registry reopen

verifiers.summary: Server-side managed Workspace lower admission and grant are proven

evidence.value: exact SHA a358f9a62b2664ad396fdf6b2f0859d5167f847c: preflight forwarded the Project source image as a workspace (overlay) selection and Enter minted its scoped grant with no target, so the Agent could prepare the pinned lower

verifiers.summary: The Sandbox workspace ownership and EROFS/Overlay fail-closed rules are proven

evidence.value: exact SHA a358f9a62b2664ad396fdf6b2f0859d5167f847c: Agent-owned writable roots were constrained to the sandbox state or Agent Workspace root; a Project Location was external, canonical and protected from Agent-owned roots; a Project Location with a lower was refused; missing erofsfuse or fuse-overlayfs stayed a fail-closed UnsupportedPolicy

verifiers.summary: A managed durable upper over a pinned Project EROFS lower survives re-entry without losing bytes

evidence.value: exact SHA a358f9a62b2664ad396fdf6b2f0859d5167f847c: a managed Workspace directory was authorized outside the execution state directory and merged with project lower sha256:70c5b9c7f78aea3f82b58f27ead5986f21236b74506ac7678f0ee33a75e052f0 through fuse-overlayfs; a sandbox write landed in the durable upper; after cleanup and a second Enter the same bytes and the same Project lower were visible, and the managed directory survived cleanup
